arena_layout: single flat DDR3 activation arena at DDR3 base 0x0100_0000, 16-byte aligned; static interval-graph packing (tensors sorted by size desc, lowest byte-disjoint offset; lifetimes [def_op,last_use] never overlap); arena base = 0 in this map

why.note: arena 819,200 B: 19 b byte (512 KB) not enough; 20 b (1 MB) has no headroom; 21 b (2 MB) = 2.4x headroom, and the reserved DDR3 window is 2 MB (0x0100_0000..0x011F_FFFF)

nn_rom_t_impact.note: P3 kickoff: Lead updates nn_pkg.sv + tools/nn_gen_rom.py and regenerates both C128/C320 ROMs; C128 values (<=0x7FFFF) are unaffected by the wider field

tile_loop_vs_flat_entries.note: 1,854 tiles > ROM depth 128 -> keep one ROM entry per op (112) + inner row-band/OC-tile/IC-block loops; tile counts are loop trip counts (see ops[].tile_est)

conv0_streaming.scan_order: output rows top->bottom; inside a band: 3 k-taps x 8 pixels, PACKED3 address = y*960 + x*3 + c (c<3), lanes 3..7 = zp_in
